notes: x86-64 Linux, NASM syntax, no libc: only the write and exit syscalls.
seed mod 139968 via reciprocal multiplication (what compilers emit); r = cvtsi2sd + divsd, the scan uses comisd.
The cumulative table is summed at run time with addsd, so it matches the other languages bit for bit.
ALU is stored with its first 84 bytes repeated, so each line is a single rep movsb; own 64 KiB output buffer.
